page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6v-c8g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. The system is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8163 processor providing 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading at 2.5 GHz. It includes 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, alongside a 33 MB L3 cache. Acceleration is delivered via four NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs providing a combined total of 64 GB VRAM (16 GB per GPU). The instance features a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and does not include local disk storage, necessitating network-attached storage.

Benchmark results demonstrate intermediate multi-core throughput alongside modest single-threaded processing. The CPU achieved a stress-ng multi-core score of 23,575.63 and a PassMark CPU score of 21,092.78, both aligning with median industry tiers. Conversely, single-threaded capabilities are lower, evidenced by a stress-ng single-core score of 1,103.89 and single-threaded gzip compression at 19.1 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth reaches 1,313.7 GB/sec for small cached blocks and 118.4 GB/sec for uncached 256MB reads, with write throughput measured at 57.05 GB/sec.

Database and auxiliary tests reflect stable mid-range performance, registering 22.1 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and a PassMark database score of 8,321.33. Static web serving throughput reached 15.55 GB/sec. Architectural tradeoffs stem from the absence of advanced vector instruction extensions such as AVX-512 and AMX, shifting primary compute intensive responsibilities to the four onboard Volta GPUs.

With its dense configuration of four discrete GPUs and balanced host memory, this instance provides cost efficiency for multi-GPU training and inference pipelines compared to single-accelerator nodes. It is primarily matched for deep learning model training, GPU-accelerated scientific simulations, parallel data processing, and high-throughput machine learning workloads requiring multi-GPU distribution.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6v-c8g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for parallel computing workloads. Based on the x86_64 architecture, it incorporates an Intel Xeon 8163 processor delivering 32 dedicated vCPUs (16 physical cores) clocked at 2.5 GHz, supported by 128.0 GB of RAM. The instance features four NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs offering 64 GB of aggregate VRAM. Networking operates at a 10 Gbps baseline, and local storage is omitted in favor of cloud-attached disks. Benchmarks show middle-tier multi-core execution (PassMark CPU score of 21,092.78 and 22.1 million Redis SET operations/sec) contrasted by weaker single-core metrics. Given its multi-GPU footprint, the server is suitable for deep learning training, scientific computing, computer vision, and parallel AI inference tasks.
